title: Egyptian decoration at the Mount Wilson lodges

tellings.quote: The lodges where astronomers stayed were reportedly decorated with Egyptian hieroglyphs and symbols

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the lodges where astronomers stayed at Mount Wilson Observatory, a telescope site above Pasadena, California, linked to the astronomer George Ellery Hale, were reportedly decorated with Egyptian hieroglyphs and symbols. He brings it up as a sign that early modern science had ties to ancient mystical traditions.
